phase: Historical baseline before the first component API depth slice
pathBase: Repository root. Declaration and dependency origins reproduce after npm ci and npm run build:packages. Markdown links point to the corresponding versioned source, example or test.
method: Current properties are resolved from the callable export of each public package declaration. DOM attributes and generic DOM children are included; they do not establish a system-authored variant or slot. The first parameter of a non-component motion helper describes its inputs. Registry evidence paths do not certify that an entire row’s proposed oracle passes. Each proposed oracle is a target for verification, not a newly claimed passing test.

nativeExpectation.oracle: In RN renderer verify the visible control receives the same testID, hit target, ref and accessible name throughout pending and disabled states. Device runs validate actual touch and type scaling.
